fixed_at: P1, before any planner result was computed

tiers.rule: hard: no safety, eligibility, resource, ordering or lock violation

tiers.definition: in-unit minutes not covered by present staff of the required skill (including tasks needing more simultaneous staff than present) + care minutes of patients assigned to the unit but still waiting for a bed + admission work still owed at the horizon end for an arrived, non-admitted patient (added in P2 after test T14 exposed a refusal incentive)

ties: habitual practice (no action) wins; then fewer reinforcement hours, fewer interventions, lower tier-1 value, plan order
